main_measure.name: mean short-direction 3-bar excess return over the coin's normal drift

statistic.name: t, cases of one day summed together

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; below 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short excess return on |forecast|, t = 0.659

decided_by: The main t lies between -2 and 2 and no reject rule is met: inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars 0,3,6,... of each window with forecast < 0 and a full 3-bar return inside the window; the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 3-bar return over all its windows; the main t is clustered by UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction; the slope t is the ordinary OLS t; the plan's 30 distinct days is applied as a minimum count.
